::: {#exr-hyena-tear-magnet}
BUILD A SLIDER APP that let's the reader choose the position and velocity and returns the rate of change of the position and velocity. Also plot out the pendulum with a little arrow indicating the direction and speed. 

THE DYNAMICAL RULE must have a pair of rates of change (one for each component of the state) for any given value of the state. THE APP shows this.

:::
